reviewer: Single scientific owner; separate source/equation audit, no agent delegation
scope: Source correctness only, neither arithmetic feasibility nor simulation admission
checks: Connected adjacency uses shared edges only: first triangle neighbours upper/left second and same-cell second; second neighbours lower/right first and same-cell first. Mask is original valid AND target AND not ground; no mask extension.

Point projection uses same calibrated pixel convention as original clearance. Actual indexed triangle is the only allowed contact; all3 vertex plane and ray membership checks retained. Unknown/disconnected lookup terminates.

Every state AND jets call activates its own facet BEFORE cached evaluation; x uniquely determines active facet with fixed material marker. States/Jac caches clear at entry/exit of endpoint search. Per-triangle normal/offset derivatives are zero; original independent FD audits test full force/torque/feet/point/objective at seed.

Original camera masks, 6mm housing buffers, all physical/action criteria and root/joint boxes remain. Existing target region finite inset is checked using original basis, while active facet finite membership is separately required.

Accepted endpoint facet is frozen before dense load and whole mesh validation. Backward connection recomputes standing gap with final measured plane. Only admitted endpoint may seed its planned connection.

No previous solver/internal coordinates read. One cold 45s construction incl component traversal, all source hashing,initialization,audits,path,serialization; no retry, fallback, extra iterations or GPU.
